headline: Brighthouse Financial Q3 Earnings Miss Estimates
summary: Brighthouse Financial reported third-quarter earnings that missed analyst expectations by $1.33 per share, with revenue also falling short of estimates.
why: Brighthouse Financial is a major provider of annuities and life insurance in the US. Earnings misses in this sector can signal challenges in investment portfolio performance or underwriting results.

impacts.name: Brighthouse Financial
impacts.why: Earnings misses typically lead to negative price adjustments.
